text: The Senezhskaya drinking-water brand is owned by Bobimex, a Russian producer of bottled water and soft drinks with more than 80 products.
short: Bobimex owns the Senezhskaya drinking-water brand.

source.name: Forbes Russia: company profile «Бобимэкс» (archived copy)
source.note: Translation: 'Industry: food industry. Facts: owner of the Senezhskaya deep drinking-water brand, producer of soft drinks based on it. The company's portfolio contains more than 80 items.' The page is Forbes's company profile for Bobimex.
